subject: Risk & Compliance
title: MLM vs Pyramid Scheme
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on MLM vs Pyramid Scheme.

hook.text: A friend invites you to an 'amazing business opportunity.' You just need to recruit five friends to get started.

buildup.text: Multi-level marketing (MLM) pays for selling products. Pyramid schemes pay for recruiting people.

discovery.text: The FTC found that in many MLMs, over 99% of participants lose money. The product is the recruitment.

twist.text: The legal line between MLM and pyramid scheme is blurry. Herbalife paid $200 million to settle FTC charges.

climax.text: If the money comes from recruiting, not from selling to real customers, it's a pyramid in disguise.

punchline.text: Recruit five friends. They recruit five. Only the top wins.

quiz.question: What distinguishes a pyramid scheme from a legitimate MLM?
options: Revenue comes from recruiting, not selling real products
